cases.sentence: «Придите, воспоем ___, вознесем хвалу с коле нашего спасения.»
cases.translation: Come, let us sing to the Lord, raise praise for our salvation.
cases.explain: The verb воспоем (sing) with a dative complement governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Придем пред лицо Его с благодарением, с ___ будем Ему восклицать.
cases.translation: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, with songs let us shout to him.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governing the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: потому что Господь — великий ___ и великий Царь над всеми богами.
cases.translation: because the Lord is a great God and a great King above all gods.
cases.explain: Бог is the predicate nominative following the copula, so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: В Его руке глубины ___ и вершины гор принадлежат Ему.
cases.translation: In his hand are the deep places of the earth and the heights of the mountains.
cases.explain: Глубины (depths) is a construct that governs the genitive case for the thing of which it contains depths.

cases.sentence: Несите ___ и идите во дворы Его.
cases.translation: Bring an offering and come into his courts.
cases.explain: Дар is the direct object of the transitive verb несите (bring), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: «Придите, поклонимся и пойдем перед Ним, преклоним колено перед ___, Создателем нашим.»
cases.translation: Come, let us worship and bow down. Let us kneel before the Lord, our Creator.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governing the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Сегодня, если услышите его голос, то не ожесточайте ваших ___.
cases.translation: Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.
cases.explain: In negation with the negative imperative, the accusative direct object takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Сорок лет я гневался на это поколение и сказал, «Сердца этого ___ заблуждаются.»
cases.translation: Forty years I was grieved with that generation and said, 'The hearts of this people err.'
cases.explain: The genitive possessive construction; the hearts belong to the people.

reading.ru: «Придите, воспоем Господу, вознесем хвалу с коле нашего спасения.»
reading.question: What does the psalmist invite people to do?
options: Sing to the Lord and raise praise for their salvation
reading.correct: Sing to the Lord and raise praise for their salvation
reading.explain: The text says 'Придите, воспоем Господу, вознесем хвалу' — Come, let us sing to the Lord, raise praise.

reading.ru: потому что Господь — великий Бог и великий Царь над всеми богами.
reading.question: Why does the psalmist call for worship?
options: Because the Lord is a great God and great King above all gods
Because the Lord is weak and needs help
Because the Lord is like other gods
Because the Lord lives far away
reading.correct: Because the Lord is a great God and great King above all gods
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Господь — великий Бог и великий Царь над всеми богами.'

reading.ru: «Придите, поклонимся и пойдем перед Ним, преклоним колено перед Господом, Создателем нашим.»
reading.question: What posture of worship does the psalmist advocate?
options: Bowing down and kneeling before the Lord, their Creator
reading.correct: Bowing down and kneeling before the Lord, their Creator
reading.explain: Поклонимся (let us worship/bow) and преклоним колено (let us kneel) describe physical postures of reverence.

reading.ru: Он наш Бог, а мы его народ, который он пасет, его овцы, о которых он заботится.
reading.question: What relationship does the text describe between God and his people?
options: God is their shepherd and they are his flock, under his care
God and the people are equals
reading.correct: God is their shepherd and they are his flock, under his care
reading.explain: The shepherd metaphor is explicit: 'пасет' (pastures/shepherds) and 'овцы' (sheep), showing God's protective relationship.

reading.ru: Сегодня, если услышите его голос, то не ожесточайте ваших сердец, как в Мериве, как это было в тот день в массе, в пустыне, где испытывали и проверяли меня ваши отцы.
reading.question: What warning does the psalmist give, and what historical comparison does he make?
options: Don't harden your hearts; remember when your fathers tested God in Meribah and Massah in the wilderness
reading.correct: Don't harden your hearts; remember when your fathers tested God in Meribah and Massah in the wilderness
reading.explain: The text warns 'не ожесточайте ваших сердец' (don't harden your hearts) and references the historical instances 'в Мериве' and 'в массе' (Meribah and Massah).

reading.ru: Поэтому я поклялся в гневе моем, они не войдут в мой покой.
reading.question: What oath did God swear in his wrath concerning the people?
options: They will not enter into his rest
They will inherit the promised land
They will rule over all nations
reading.correct: They will not enter into his rest
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'они не войдут в мой покой' — they will not enter into my rest.
